name: Resolve a multi-file configuration merge regression
prompt: Work as a coding agent in the provided repository. Resolve the reported configuration merge regression: nested mappings must merge recursively, lists must replace rather than concatenate, null in an overlay must explicitly clear a value, and neither input may be mutated. Preserve the public API, add focused regression tests, run the project tests, and leave the repository in a maintainable state. Do not edit or bypass benchmark infrastructure.
